# Docker Workflow Runbook

## Verification Commands
- Build image: `docker compose build`
- Start services: `docker compose up -d`
- Check container logs: `docker compose logs -f <service>`
- Stop services: `docker compose down`

## Agent Safety Rules
- Never run `docker system prune -a` without explicit confirmation.
- Always preserve mounted volume data during testing.

# Frontend Development Runbook

## Commands
- Dev server: `cd graph-ui && npm run dev`
- Production build: `cd graph-ui && npm run build`
- Run tests: `cd graph-ui && npm test`

## Styling & Architecture
- Use designated theme tokens and Lucide icons.
- Do not break existing responsive layout rules.
